description: Deletes a campaign as Delete on its card does: its queued messages are pulled back first; messages already sent stay in their threads. It cannot be undone; to stop it for now, edit_campaign with status paused. Pass the same idempotency_key when retrying.

idempotency_key.description: Your id for this operation (8-128 of A-Z a-z 0-9 . _ : -). Reuse it on every retry of the same operation; use a new one for a new operation.

name: delete_campaign
title: Delete a campaign
